machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory, macOS 26.6.2
scope: Parked experiment: Viggle's 4-step DMD distillation of Qwen-Image-2.1 versus the base model at 25 steps with and without Cache-DiT 0.16, all through the unchanged fresh-process native 1024x1024 prompt-to-PNG path

superseded.note: The parked verdict was judged on a prompt that did not quote CASABLANCA. On the quoted-text prompt the pack renders both strings exactly and is the adopted model. Its steps and schedule now come from pack metadata (kind=distilled steps=4 shift_terminal=none); the environment switches below are no longer needed. The 9.8 s VAE and 57.7 s total predate MPSGraph convolution and the fixed-cost pass.

distilled_checkpoint.status_per_model_card: v0.1 preview; text may garble more often than the 40-step base
distilled_checkpoint.inventory: 297 BF16 tensors and 7,115,124,736 parameters, identical names and shapes to the pinned base transformer
distilled_checkpoint.scheduler_difference: shift_terminal null instead of 0.02; every other scheduler field matches the base

packing.method: A throwaway Python splitter copied tensor bytes verbatim into the base index's two-shard partition (211 + 86 tensors) so the unchanged quantize-transformer could consume it
packing.verification: structural verify plus exact source round-trip passed
packing.identity_caveat: The header still records the base snapshot because the loader requires it; the pack is experiment-only and must not be treated as the pinned model.

runtime_switches.steps: generate-1024 accepts 4 as an experiment-only step count
runtime_switches.schedule: QI_EXPERIMENT_NO_SHIFT_TERMINAL=1 skips the terminal stretch; the log recorded model timesteps 1000, 857.192, 666.756, and 400.096, matching the unit test

input.prompt: A vintage travel poster for CASABLANCA reading 'MEET ME AT SUNSET', bold geometric lettering.

runs.name: viggle_4_step
runs.text_result: CASABLANCA absent; 'MEET ME AT' rendered as 'MEET MEAT'; SUNSET legible with a malformed U
runs.visual_result: Coherent painterly Moroccan harbor scene; style departs from the base model's flat poster

runs.name: base_25_step_cache_off
runs.text_result: CASABLANCA garbled beyond recognition; 'MEET ME AT' and SUNSET exact; invented footer text 'CASSEE' and 'AULNAT'
runs.visual_result: Clean flat Art Deco poster matching the 40-step composition family

runs.name: base_25_step_cache_dit_0_16
runs.text_result: 'CASABLANCHA' (one inserted letter); 'MEET ME AT' and SUNSET exact; no invented footer text
runs.visual_result: Layout nearly identical to the 25-step cache-off image

power_state.viggle_run: AC Power; battery 80-81%; charging; no thermal or performance warning recorded
power_state.ordering: Viggle first, then base 25 cache-off, then base 25 Cache-DiT, sequentially on one machine

findings: The distilled checkpoint runs unchanged on the native runtime at the same per-step cost (8.96 s average) and completes 1024 prompt-to-PNG in 57.7 s, 2.5x faster than the fastest exact-text path (40-step Cache-DiT 0.16, 145.18 s).
It fails the exact-text gate by omitting CASABLANCA, so it is parked rather than promoted.
At four steps, work outside the denoising loop (VAE 9.8 s, transformer setup 8.2 s, text 3.5 s) is 38% of end-to-end time.
Twenty-five steps is not text-safe at 1024 on this prompt: cache-off garbles CASABLANCA and Cache-DiT 0.16 inserts one letter. The earlier 25-step acceptance came from a text-free 256 teapot.
These are single-prompt, single-seed observations; the text comparison between the two 25-step runs is not evidence that Cache-DiT improves quality.
result: Viggle v0.1 parked: fastest measured 1024 path, but fails exact text
